notes.title: ShiraVN Dark Dreamers Bundle Now On Sale!
notes.content:
Introducing the ShiraVN Dark Dreamers Bundle! This special collection includes both Waffle's [i]Eden's Ritter: Paladins of Ecstasy[/i] and Soiree's [i]Salthe[/i], two dark, mature games localized by [url=https://store.steampowered.com/developer/ShiraVN]ShiraVN[/url] that explore themes of hope and despair. Buy them both to get 10% OFF, anytime!

But that's not all—to celebrate, [i]Eden's Ritter: Paladins of Ecstasy[/i] will also be on sale for 15% OFF through Monday, September 21! During this period, buying both games together will give a whopping [b][i]23.5% OFF[/i][/b] on these new games for new purchasers, or on either game for players who already own one!

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/16203/

[h3]About [i][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1127540/Edens_Ritter_Paladins_of_Ecstasy/]Eden's Ritter: Paladins of Ecstasy[/url][/i][/h3]

A darkly erotic medieval fantasy visual novel. Join Princess Cecily in her desperate struggle against the forces of evil that seek to overthrow her holy kingdom and thrust the world into carnal chaos!

[h3]About [i][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1357840/Salthe/]Salthe[/url][/i][/h3]

A dramatically dark visual novel. On a stage at the boundary between life and death, an actress struggles through her hardest performance—directed by a jester, she relives her past for the the prize of resurrection...
